name: Andrew Ariotti
title: Senior Manager of Web Marketing, Ivanti
review: Seth worked on my team at Ivanti the past several years. He hit the ground running with code that he hadn't written himself in a CMS that he wasn't familiar with. He excelled and became a huge asset to the team in no time! We had a HUGE redesign project a few weeks ago that he was working around the clock to get done. Nights/weekends, he did what it took to get it done. The end product was awesome and he accomplished even more than we had anticipated. So glad that our paths crossed and excited to see his front end dev skills continue to grow!

name: Jack Rowley
title: Full-Stack Engineering Director, Ivanti
review:
I highly recommend Seth Baldridge for any senior or leadership role in front-end development. Having managed Seth directly for nearly five years during our time at Ivanti, I had the privilege of watching him consistently deliver exceptional results as our Lead Front End Developer. 

Seth is a remarkably knowledgeable front-end engineer who brings deep technical expertise to every project he touches. During his tenure, he successfully spearheaded numerous front-end development initiatives, transforming complex requirements into clean, scalable, and high-performing code. 

Beyond his technical strengths, Seth excels as a leader. He guided our front-end projects with a clear vision, mentored junior developers, and fostered a collaborative, high-performing environment within the team. He has a rare combination of hands-on coding mastery and the leadership skills necessary to drive major engineering projects across the finish line. 

Seth was a vital asset to my team at Ivanti, and I have no doubt he will bring the same level of excellence, dedication, and technical leadership to his next role. He has my highest recommendation.
